claim: Skin, white-cloth and red-skirt median/highlight lightness satisfy the unchanged diagnostic limits for all active frames. 104 other material diagnostics remain; this is not an all-color-thresholds pass.

dispositions.reason: Red lightness is calibrated and within the diagnostic L limits. The flag concerns unchanged chroma/saturation distribution, including highlighted trim/fold proportions. Accepted texture/color structure is preserved; no chroma redesign was requested.

Hair lightness is not normalized. Original dark-hair texture/highlight structure retained. Reference ROI samples the portrait dark hair; pose proxy samples top-of-figure dark pixels and can include bracers in rotated poses. Visible black-hair variation remains a limited material exception; no all-material numeric pass is claimed.
